title: what can I get for you?
expression: What can I get for you today?

sentences.en: Hey there, Sheldon. What can I get for you today?
No, nothing fun today. I need to learn how to make a friend.
sentences.ko: 아뇨, 오늘은 재미있는 건 됐어요. 친구 사귀는 법을 배워야 해서요.

sentences.en: Aw, honey, you having a hard time adjusting to high school?
I'm having a hard time adjusting to Earth.
Try this. It's been around a while, but it's still quite popular.
sentences.ko: 이걸 한번 봐. 나온 지는 좀 됐지만 여전히 인기가 많아.

sentences.en: Unlike me, who's just been around a while.
sentences.ko: 나온 지만 오래된 나랑은 다르게 말이야.
